content:
Is Instantly falling behind? My cold email results dropped sharply.
I've been using Instantly to send cold emails with a properly warmed-up domain and clean sending behavior no links in the body, plain text, no attachments. Still, I’m seeing open rates dropping significantly, and replies are becoming rare.

Interestingly, when I tried the same setup using Mailchimp and Mailgo, the results were noticeably better.

Nothing in my copy or targeting changed just the platform.

Has anyone else noticed a decline in deliverability or performance with Instantly recently?

Could it be due to how they rotate IPs or inbox placement strategies?

Would love to hear your thoughts or recommendations.
